facts.premium: Near the southern norm; large rural population on rubber, fruit and rice keeps average incomes low and cash-based.
facts.skill_gap: Predominantly farm and informal labour; formal manufacturing is thin (~20k factory workers) relative to a workforce of ~850k.
impacts: Tapping income is the backbone of rural Nakhon Si Thammarat and rises/falls with rubber prices.
Mangosteen/durian/longkong income is lumpy and harvest-timed, stressing repayment between seasons.
Nakhon Si Thammarat is among the most flood-prone southern provinces; monsoon floods cut income and can damage motorcycle collateral.
58% of vehicles are motorcycles — high-volume, smaller-ticket title loans dominate.
Few large employers means little stable salaried buffer against farm-price shocks.
Big dispersed population on rubber/fruit cash supports broad branch coverage and cross-sell.
